verdict.rationale: The pack holds substantive text extracted from several public bamf.de pages: the English homepage, the German homepage and the deeper Migration and Residence section. That implies the guidance pages were fetched and returned readable content rather than a bot wall, CAPTCHA or empty JS shell. None of the evidence directly addresses agent access, so this rests on inference from successful retrieval. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that a keyless agent with an identified user agent can fetch pages, absence of CAPTCHA or bot-protection layers, confirmation that content is server-rendered rather than JS-dependent, and robots or crawler policy evidence.
